description: This PHP class 'BuzzLikeDao' provides data access methods for managing 'likes' on shares and comments within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes methods for saving, deleting, retrieving, and counting likes, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders and search filter parameters.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing 'like' entities related to shares and comments in the Buzz plugin.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnShare entity and returns it.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnComment entity and returns it.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Deletes a like on a share based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Deletes a like on a comment based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare entity by share ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment entity by comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Returns a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query wrapper for BuzzLikeOnShare with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Returns a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query wrapper for BuzzLikeOnComment with filtering and sorting.
